title: Lindauer Dornier — Grokipedia
content: Lindauer DORNIER GmbH is a family-owned mechanical engineering company based in Lindau, Germany, specializing in advanced machinery and systems for weaving, film production, and lightweight construction.](#ref-1)](#ref-2) Founded in 1950 by Peter Dornier, son of aviation pioneer Claude Dornier, the company emerged from the post-World War II diversification of the Dornier aircraft manufacturing legacy into textile machinery.](#ref-1)](#ref-3) Over its more than 75 years of operation, Lindauer DORNIER has established itself as a global leader in innovation and precision engineering, beginning with shuttle weaving machines in the 1950s and pioneering the world's first shuttleless rapier weaving machine in 1967, which revolutionized textile production.](#ref-1) The company expanded its portfolio to include air-jet weaving systems and modular "Green Machine" families known for sustainability, longevity, and reliability in producing high-quality technical textiles used in industries such as automotive, aerospace, and medical applications.](#ref-1) In film production, Lindauer DORNIER develops stretching lines for materials like BOPET, emphasizing efficiency, flexibility, and sustainability to create high-quality packaging and technical films.](#ref-4)](#ref-5) Its lightweight construction solutions leverage textile expertise for composite materials, supporting applications in advanced manufacturing.](#ref-6) With approximately 1,000 employees and a commitment to "Made in Germany" quality, the firm continues to drive technological advancements, as evidenced by its participation in international trade shows like ITMA Asia + CITME 2025.](#ref-7)](#ref-1).

title: 50 Years Brückner - World Market Leadership Strengthened
content: Over decades, not only was Brückner able to secure, but also to strengthen their position as world market leader for film stretching lines – within the entire BO market as well as in the BOPP segment. As to BOPET, Brückner has been able to gain a significant market share in recent years. For Brückner Maschinenbau, China has by far been the most important market for many years. Although a downturn is presently being observed for lines for standard packaging film in China, this shall, above all, be compensated by the demand for production lines for technical film (e.g. BOPET thick film). In Western Europe, USA, Japan, Taiwan and Korea, only a few large lines are being ordered to meet the slightly increased demand for standard film. At K 2010 the company presents new line concepts for more efficiency and sustainability in plastics film production as well as for the manufacture of trend-setting specialty films.
